title: story-021's _recomputeSchedule() in finalizeAndReset introduces two external calls into the only path back to Active
description: The price-scaled delta adds `nftMinter.configs(dispatcherIndex)` and `dispatcherHook.mintDebt()` to `finalizeAndReset` (NFTStakerDepletion.finalizeAndReset makes none). A reverting hook or minter therefore newly wedges the pool in `Migrating`, which blocks `InPlaceNFTStakerMigrator.migrateIn` because `depositFor` requires Active. The delta itself is CORRECT for the emission model — it closes the depletion copy's ledgered L-02 on this copy — the finding is the new dependency it drags in.
impact: Availability only, non-terminal. A reverting hook or minter newly wedges the pool in Migrating, which blocks InPlaceNFTStakerMigrator.migrateIn because depositFor requires Active.
attackPath: 1. The price-scaled delta adds nftMinter.configs(dispatcherIndex) and dispatcherHook.mintDebt() to finalizeAndReset (NFTStakerDepletion.finalizeAndReset makes no external calls).
2. Either dependency reverting makes finalizeAndReset revert.
3. finalizeAndReset is the only transition back to Active, so the pool is wedged in Migrating.
4. Recovery: setDispatcherHook(address(0)) is ungated and performs NO recompute, so it always succeeds and immediately un-wedges.
likelihood: low — requires a dependency to break.
assumptions: A hook or minter is wired and reverts.
justification: Low. Availability only, verified non-terminal and unwedgeable BY EXECUTION: setDispatcherHook(address(0)) always succeeds and un-wedges; setNFTMinter is legal once drained; parked stake exits via claimTimedOut regardless; emergencyWithdraw bypasses the hook entirely. The delta itself is CORRECT for the emission model — it closes the depletion copy's ledgered L-02 on this copy — so the finding is the new dependency it drags in, not the recompute.

poc.note: Unwedge proven by execution (setDispatcherHook(address(0)) always succeeds).
